units.text: In keeping with tradition, Apple has taken down the Apple Store this morning ahead of the iPhone Duo going up for preorder. If you are waiting to buy the new Apple foldable, be sure to log on at 5 AM Eastern Time.

All reports point to constrained supply and relatively high demand, so everyone is anticipating that Apple will run out of launch day stock very quickly indeed. If you want a Duo for launch day, on October 23, you need to be ready to buy at 5 AM.

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable, featuring a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer display when closed. Apple has engineered the product to feature a minimal crease when unfolded, aided by a custom hinge design and a nano-texture matte finish on the inner display.

It is powered by Apple’s latest A20 Pro chip, and should offer computational performance in the ballpark of the iPhone 18 Pro line. The cameras are a downgrade though, due to the device’s thinner design when unfolded, and the Duo only has Touch ID rather than Face ID biometrics.
The Duo comes in two colors, Night Sky and Star White, and starts at $1999 for the entry-level 256 GB model.

iPhone Duo will launch with iOS 27.1, which will include a bunch of software UI optimisations for the product’s unusual form factor. This includes a new vertical bar where all the controls in updated apps appear along the right-edge of the phone, making them easy to tap with your thumb.
All of Apple’s apps have also been updated to smoothly expand between the outer display and the larger inner display, and app developers are also submitting compatibility updates as we speak.

While foldables in general make up a small percentage of overall smartphone sales, Apple’s entrance into the category is expected to make a mark. We think the Duo will be a big hit, at least relatively to the competition.
Whether Apple can manufacture enough of them will be the problem, at least for the first few months. Reports have indicated Apple’s suppliers will ship about 7-10 million Duos for the rest of 2026.

IT之家注意到，这是库克时隔 3 年再次公开前往米哈游总部。库克曾在 2023 年 3 月进行了一次中国行，受邀来参加 3 月 25 日至 27 日在北京举行的中国发展高层论坛。除了商务会谈等必要工作外，库克还频繁探店、开会、与各种人合影留念。

库克本月再次来华，首站落地广东广州，与运动员苏炳添一起喝早茶，然后前往北京参观了爱奇艺公司、视察苹果三里屯 Apple Store，还参加了清华经管学院顾问委员会 2026 年会，与我国商务部部长王文涛进行交流。

units.text: 苹果公司宣布，旗下首款折叠屏智能手机 iPhone Duo 于10月16日正式开启预订。该产品于上个月与 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 一同发布。与两款 Pro 机型在发布当周便启动预售并已上市销售不同，iPhone Duo 的预订时间被安排在今天协调世界时（UTC）12时开始。
根据苹果公布的信息，消费者可通过苹果官方网站以及 Apple Store 应用程序在全球70多个国家和地区预订 iPhone Duo，包括澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、中国、哥伦比亚、法国、德国、印度、日本、马来西亚、墨西哥、新加坡、韩国、土耳其、阿联酋、英国、美国和越南等主要市场。
苹果表示，首批市场的发货和正式开售时间定于10月23日。随后，iPhone Duo 还将于10月30日起在另外28个国家和地区上市销售，进一步扩大其市场覆盖范围。
在定价方面，iPhone Duo 成为苹果当前产品线中售价最高的手机之一。主要市场的起售价分别为：美国市场1999美元、德国市场2299欧元、英国市场1999英镑、印度市场299900卢比、中国市场15999元人民币、日本市场364800日元。
作为对比，iPhone 18 Pro 的起售价分别为美国1199美元、德国1449欧元、英国1199英镑、印度164900卢比、中国9999元人民币、日本219800日元；iPhone 18 Pro Max 的起售价则分别为美国1299美元、德国1599欧元、英国1299英镑、印度179900卢比、中国10999元人民币、日本239800日元。
随着预订通道正式开启，iPhone Duo 也成为苹果进军折叠屏手机市场的重要产品。该机型此前已在发布会上亮相，标志着苹果首次推出折叠屏智能手机，并将与现有的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列共同构成苹果新一代高端手机阵容。

软件方面，该机充分利用大屏空间，主屏幕上的程序坞采用竖向布局，控制项放在了方便拇指操作的位置。手机支持同时操作两个应用，支持半折叠使用，可秒变日历、闹钟、桌面音箱。

units.text: 苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo于当地时间10月16日正式开启预购，标志着这款备受关注的新产品进入上市前的最后阶段。苹果在线商店已恢复运行，用户可以通过苹果官方网站或Apple Store应用程序下单。不过，随着预购需求逐渐增加，部分热门配置的发货时间预计可能延后。
苹果此次继续采用排队购买机制。用户进入在线商店后，需要等待系统轮到自己，才能访问正式的订购页面。苹果并不会在所有用户访问商店时立即开放下单入口，因此，不同地区以及通过不同渠道访问商店的消费者，可能会在不同时间获得购买资格。
在预购正式开始之前，苹果已经开放了预先配置功能。消费者可以提前选择手机的颜色、存储容量以及付款方式，从而在预购启动后更快完成订单。对于希望在首发当天拿到新机的用户而言，提前完成这些准备工作可能有助于缩短下单流程。
本次预购于美国太平洋时间10月16日凌晨5时、美国东部时间上午8时开始。由于苹果的全球内容分发系统需要在不同地区的数据中心逐步恢复运行，官方网站和Apple Store应用程序的访问情况可能存在差异。如果用户暂时无法进入商店，可以尝试切换官方网站与Apple Store应用程序。
价格方面，iPhone Duo的256GB版本起售价为1999美元，而存储容量最高的2TB版本售价达到3199美元，以上价格均未扣除旧设备折抵优惠或运营商促销优惠。不同存储容量之间的价格差距，也意味着消费者需要根据实际使用需求权衡购买成本。
iPhone Duo是苹果推出的首款折叠屏iPhone。与传统直板iPhone不同，这款设备能够通过展开机身获得更大的显示区域。苹果表示，展开后的屏幕面积比iPhone 18 Pro Max大约高出50%，使其在浏览网页、阅读文档、观看视频以及处理多任务时具备更大的显示空间。
苹果计划于10月23日正式发售iPhone Duo。随着首批预购订单陆续进入处理流程，热门颜色、存储容量和配置的供货情况可能发生变化，部分消费者或许无法在上市首日收到设备。
iPhone Duo的推出，也意味着苹果正式进入折叠屏智能手机市场。此前，这一市场已经有三星等厂商持续布局。三星Galaxy Z Fold系列以及其他折叠屏设备已经积累了多代产品经验，苹果则需要通过自身的硬件设计、操作系统适配和应用生态，吸引消费者接受这种新的iPhone形态。
对于苹果而言，iPhone Duo不仅是一款屏幕更大的手机，也将考验iOS系统如何适应可折叠设备。更大的内部屏幕可以为应用提供额外的显示空间，但要充分发挥这一优势，应用程序还需要适配展开与折叠两种状态，并在屏幕切换时保持合理的布局和操作体验。
目前，苹果已经进入预购阶段，消费者很快就能通过实际使用检验这款设备的折叠设计、软件体验和日常便利性。不过，1999美元的起售价以及3199美元的顶配价格，也使iPhone Duo成为苹果产品线中价格较高的设备之一。它能否在已经竞争激烈的折叠屏市场获得广泛认可，将取决于消费者对其设计、功能和价格的综合评价。

units.text: Few phones have been more anticipated than a foldable iPhone, but it’s finally here. The iPhone Duo was unveiled during Apple’s “Surprise and shine” event alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 models.

Apple’s first foldable has a 5.4-inch outer screen, and it unfolds to show off its 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR screen. Apple Pencil support is coming later this year. While it lacks Face ID for facial unlocking, there’s a Touch ID sensor along its edge to identify your fingerprint. The device has an IP68 rating, with Ceramic Shield 2 on its back, with Ceramic Shield covering the front display. It has the same A20 Pro chipset as the iPhone 18 Pro. Notably, the Duo has the same 48-megapixel fusion camera as the 18 Pro, though it doesn’t have variable aperture.

The foldable will come in two colors, Star White and Night Sky, and starts at $1,999 for the 256GB version. You can preorder an unlocked version now ahead of its Friday, October 23rd release date from Apple and Best Buy.

units.text: iPhone Duo Now Available to Pre-Order From Apple

Apple is now accepting pre-orders for the iPhone Duo through its online storefront and Apple Store app. If you don't see the option to order, refresh both the website and the app until the store loads.
Pre-orders for the ‌iPhone Duo‌ are launching in more than 70 countries and regions. Customers who used the "Get Ready" option to set up a purchase should be able to check out with a couple of taps.

The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is Apple's first foldable smartphone. It features a 5.4-inch display when closed and a 7.6-inch display when open. It has an iPad-like aspect ratio and at 5.2mm when unfolded, it is Apple's thinnest iPhone to date.

Apple designed the ‌iPhone Duo‌ with an aluminum and titanium frame, complete with ceramic fiber antenna inserts and support ribs. It has a hinge with more than 100 components, and can be used in multiple orientations and positions. It lacks Face ID and adopts Touch ID instead, and it has a two-lens camera system without a telephoto lens.

The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is priced starting at $1,999 for 256GB of storage, and it comes in star white and night sky colors. Apple says its specialists are available to help users find ways to save and pay, including with Apple Upgrade, a Klarna-run lease program. With a 24-month lease, ‌iPhone Duo‌ pricing starts at $57.99 per month. Apple says customers can save from $175 to $885 by trading in an eligible iPhone 13 or newer.
If you're ordering an ‌iPhone Duo‌, it's a good idea to opt for AppleCare+. Some ‌iPhone Duo‌ repair fees are as high as $1,499 without a protection plan.

Along with Apple, carriers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile are accepting ‌iPhone Duo‌ pre-orders. Carriers have trade-in deals and discounts available, but make sure to read all of the fine print ahead of time.
Rumors suggest ‌iPhone Duo‌ supplies are limited due to production issues. The new iPhone could sell out quickly, so order right away if you want one on launch day.
Customers who successfully pre-order an ‌iPhone Duo‌ for launch day delivery will get their devices on Friday, October 23.

units.text: Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini Price Increases 'Much More Striking' Than New Features

Daring Fireball's John Gruber shared his first impressions of the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2 this week, and he concluded that the price increases the devices received are "much more striking" than any of the new features introduced.

Prior to receiving price increases in late June, the previous Apple TV 4K started at $129 in the U.S., while the previous HomePod mini was priced at $99. The new Apple TV and the HomePod mini 2 are priced at $299 and $149, respectively, so both devices are now significantly more expensive than they were just four months ago.

Since the new Apple TV is only available in a single configuration with 128GB of storage and an Ethernet port, it is more fair to compare it to the equivalent previous-generation 128GB model, which was initially $149 and went up to $249 in late June. This means the new model is technically only $50 more expensive, but the reality is that the minimum you can spend on a new Apple TV 4K is now $299, up significantly from $129.

The price increases stack up if you want to use a pair of HomePod mini speakers as the default audio output on an Apple TV 4K. As noted by Gruber, it now costs nearly $600 to buy all of those devices, up from nearly $350 before late June.

"At the old pre-June prices, you could buy a 128 GB Apple TV and a pair of HomePod Minis for $350 ($150 + $100 + $100)," said Gruber. "Four short months later, with today's new models, that combination would cost $600 ($300 + $150 + $150). That price difference is much more striking than any of the new and improved features in the products."

To be clear, Gruber said he still thinks the new Apple TV 4K is "worth it" to him at its current price, and he believes the HomePod mini 2's price is "reasonable." However, he acknowledges that the "general consumer market thought the old prices were too high," and now Apple has made even more price increases on top.

units.text: Apple unveiled three new Home products this week: HomeView, HomePod mini 2, and a new Apple TV 4K. While there’s no new full-size HomePod launching, Apple did announce three features coming to the existing HomePod 2 via a free software update.
#1: Sound Glow
If you have an Apple Intelligence-compatible iPhone, your HomePod will get the new Sound Glow feature that’s also coming to HomePod mini 2.
Per Apple’s webpage for HomePod (2nd generation): “with Sound Glow, the top of your HomePod lights up with colors that match your album artwork, pulsing in tune with the music.”
The HomePod mini 2 announcement adds more details, which hopefully will be the same on the larger HomePod:

With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini transforms into a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with the music, reacting in real time to bass and treble. The song’s album artwork from Now Playing generates a color-matched light experience that’s unique to every song, and users can pick a soundscape like rain to trigger bespoke animations for a soothing atmosphere.
#2: Default speaker for Mac
Apple has long let you use a HomePod as a speaker for your Mac via AirPlay. But soon, you’ll be able to set HomePod as the default Mac speaker for a more seamless, reliable connection.
Like Sound Glow, Apple announced this feature for HomePod mini 2, but its fine print says:
Compatible with HomePod mini 2 and HomePod (2nd generation) with support on all Mac desktops and laptops with Wi-Fi 6E or later.
So if you want to upgrade your Mac speaker setup with the HomePod, or a stereo pair of HomePods, that will soon be easier than ever.
#3: Surround sound with four HomePods and Apple TV 4K
If you want the best, all-Apple home theater experience, a new surround sound feature for HomePod and Apple TV 4K will deliver that.
Exclusive to the new Apple TV 4K (4th gen), users can set up four HomePods—two as front speakers, two as rear—for a more immersive audio experience.
From Apple’s press release:

Home theater surround sound requires four HomePod mini 2 or HomePod (2nd generation) speakers in matching pairs (front and rear), paired with Apple TV 4K (4th generation) running the latest operating system software.
Apple hasn’t yet confirmed when these new features are launching on HomePod, but they’re expected to debut with iOS 27.2 and HomePod 27.2 later this month.

Apple’s legal team overhaul continues
Earlier this year, Meta’s former chief legal officer Jennifer Newstead joined Apple as its new general counsel, replacing longtime executive Kate Adams.
Newstead’s responsibilities eventually expanded to include government affairs following the retirement of Lisa Jackson, who had previously overseen the division.

The changes brought Apple’s legal and government affairs teams under a single executive, with former CEO Tim Cook, now Apple’s executive chairman, also remaining directly involved in managing the company’s government relations.
As part of the reorganization, Apple also hired former American Airlines executive Nate Gatten as its new vice president of government affairs.

Now, Bloomberg reports that Newstead is bringing in a former colleague from Meta, Scott Tucker, who joined Mark Zuckerberg’s company in 2021 and previously held a senior legal position at Morgan Stanley.
The company has hired Scott Tucker, a longtime deputy general counsel and litigation chief at Meta, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

Tucker is becoming Apple’s vice president of global litigation and financial services, a newly created position overseeing commercial and patent litigation worldwide, said the people, who asked not to be named because the move isn’t public. He’ll also manage legal matters involving the company’s financial offerings.

The report adds that as a result of Tucker joining the company, Heather Grenier, Apple’s vice president of commercial and competition litigation, will now report to him rather than directly to Newstead. Bloomberg notes, however, that Grenier will retain her position on Newstead’s legal leadership team.

Finally, Bloomberg says Apple is also expanding the responsibilities of longtime legal executive Kyle Andeer, who will now oversee matters involving “international legal matters and functions involving online child safety, cybersecurity and law enforcement.”

units.text: Verizon Will Charge $10 a Month for iPhone Handoff
Verizon plans to charge customers $10 per month for the iPhone Handoff feature that Apple added in iOS 27. iPhone Handoff allows one phone number to be shared across two separate iPhones.
Pricing was included in Verizon's iPhone Duo announcement today, with the carrier confirming iPhone Handoff will work with the iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro models.

Verizon will support iPhone Handoff, giving customers the flexibility to use a single Verizon phone number seamlessly across two compatible iPhone models. Whether using the pocketable iPhone Duo on the go or iPhone 18 Pro for work, customers can switch active status between devices at any time while keeping full access to Verizon's 5G network. iPhone Handoff will be available from Verizon for $10/month on compatible iPhones models running iOS 27.

With iPhone Handoff, users can switch between a main iPhone and a companion iPhone at will, though a phone number can only be active on one iPhone at a time. Verizon says support is "coming soon," and Apple previously said Verizon would adopt the feature before the end of the year.

U.S. carrier T-Mobile already supports iPhone Handoff, but charges just $5 per month for the feature. AT&T, the third major U.S. carrier, recently suggested it has no imminent plans to support iPhone Handoff.

U.K. carrier EE also said this week that it will soon support iPhone Handoff. Customers who have EE's Full Works Plus plan will get iPhone Handoff free, while other EE users can get it for £5 per month.
Deutsche Telekom in Germany is the only other carrier that's added iPhone Handoff support so far. It costs €6.95 per month, but the carrier includes it for free in the MagentaMobil L and XL plans.

During Apple’s “Surprise and Shine” event last month, the company shared more details about iPhone Handoff, a new iOS 27 feature first previewed at WWDC that lets users share a single phone number across two iPhones.
Apple announced that the feature would initially be supported by T-Mobile and Deutsche Telekom, with Verizon and EE expected to follow before the end of the year.

Shortly after the event, T-Mobile confirmed a $5 monthly fee for iPhone Handoff, while Deutsche Telekom made the feature available through its existing MultiSIM service, which costs €6.95 per month unless already included in the customer’s plan.
Today, as spotted by MacRumors, Verizon also confirmed its pricing for iPhone Handoff, announcing that it will charge $10 per month, twice as much as T-Mobile.

Verizon will support iPhone Handoff, giving customers the flexibility to use a single Verizon phone number seamlessly across two compatible iPhone models. units.text: 快科技10月16日消息，一块由史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克（Steve Wozniak）亲笔签名的"哈特菲尔德"Apple-1电脑，在纽约邦翰斯（Bonhams）举行的科学、技术与计算史拍卖会上以115万美元（快科技注：约770万元人民币）成交，10月14日落槌，创下Apple-1商业出售的世界拍卖纪录。
这件拍品能拍到这个价，签名和信函是两个关键原因，主板顶部边缘有沃兹的亲笔签名，还附带一封1978年史蒂夫·乔布斯（Steve Jobs）签署的信，收件人是这台电脑的原主人弗雷德·哈特菲尔德（Fred Hatfield），信里给他提供了换购当时刚发布的Apple II的优惠。
沃兹和乔布斯两个人都在同一件东西上留了字，这种组合在现存Apple-1里几乎找不到第二件。
竞价过程持续了28分钟，最终在两名竞拍者之间成交，成交价是估价的两倍多。
邦翰斯北美精美书籍与手稿部主任Ian Ehling表示，能在苹果公司成立50周年之际拍出苹果的第一件产品是一件荣幸，而这台电脑引来的激烈竞价，正好印证了它的稀有性和持久吸引力。
这件拍品的身份也很明确，它在Apple-1注册表里编号为第48号，是目前已知存世的不到75台经过认证的Apple-1之一，而今天仍能正常运行的更是极少数中的极少数——能开机、能工作，这是它比同批存世品更值钱的地方。
主板本身保存得相当完整，尺寸230×395毫米，属于第二批次，元件面标有"Apple Computer 1 / Palo Alto. Ca. Copyright 1976"，下方盖着"NTI"钢印。
核心是一颗白色陶瓷封装的MOS Technology 6502处理器，配8KB内存、3颗原装Sprague"Big Blue"电容、键盘接口和连接器、扩展连接器、磁带板连接器，以及原装苹果磁带接口板。
顺带解释一下为什么它是一块板而不是一台完整电脑，Apple-1当年就是以裸主板的形式出售的，买家得自己配机箱、电源和键盘，所以今天说"Apple-1电脑"，多数时候指的就是这块主板。

units.text: I previously tested the difference the wider aperture of the iPhone 18 Pro makes when it comes to depth of field. The executive summary is that the difference is small, but definitely present.

I said at the time that I’d intended to test the difference it made to Night mode shots when an unmissable night video opportunity had me write about that instead. So belatedly, let me turn my attention to Night mode photos …

Once the ship had passed through the bridge, I stuck around to return to plan A: testing Night mode still photos. The new variable aperture lens offers two complementary advantages for night photography: allowing us to either increase or reduce the shutter speed depending on the effect we’re looking for.
Faster shutter speed

The widest aperture is boosted from f/1.8 to f/1.48. The wider the aperture, the more light captured for any given period of time. That should mean that Night mode shots have a shorter duration, meaning we don’t have to hold the phone still for quite so long. The shorter the duration, the lower the chances that inadvertent movement will spoil the shot.

I tested this with a number of shots and found that while the difference in duration was indeed rather small, as we’d expect from less than one stop of extra light, it may be enough to help in some circumstances.
For example, for this shot, switching from f/1.8 to f/1.48 reduced the duration from 2.1 seconds to 1.7 seconds.

Other test shots showed similar results. The biggest differences are likely to be in the darkest of environments, like astrophotography. However, living in London, this is about as dark as it ever gets, and we never get to see stars, so that wasn’t something I could test.
Slower shutter speed

Conversely, there may be times when we actually want a slower shutter speed. For example, having the shutter open for a longer period helps to smooth out choppy water, which can give a more pleasing appearance.

By manually reducing the aperture to the maximum of f/4 (a larger number is a smaller aperture), I was able to increase the exposure time to 4 seconds. This did indeed help give the water a smoother appearance.

This helps significantly with reflections on the water. For example, check out the reflections of the four spotlights on the floating pontoon under the Discover London from the Water sign. Drag the slider left and right to compare:
The other benefit of the smaller aperture is the starburst effect you get from lights. Again, compare those pontoon spotlights as well as the street lamp on the left.

However, if you want the ultimate glassy water effect, then you need a significantly longer exposure. On a standalone camera, the usual exposure we choose for this type of shot is 30 seconds, typically at f/16 or f/22, and on an iPhone that requires a third-party app to combine multiple shots into one. The shot below was taken from the same place using the Spectre app I reviewed back in 2024. This was a 30-second exposure taken on my iPhone 16 Pro Max, and you can see that it gives the water an ice-like glassy-smooth appearance:
Conclusions

Is the variable aperture lens enough reason to upgrade from the iPhone 17 Pro to the iPhone 18 Pro? Probably not. But if you’ve been considering an upgrade from an older iPhone, then these benefits might be enough to tip the balance.

units.text: 随着苹果首款可折叠手机 iPhone Duo 开启预购，其官方配件细节也陆续曝光。根据已经在零售店接触到产品的用户反馈，苹果售价79美元的 iPhone Duo 官方保护壳并非通过卡扣或磁吸方式固定，而是依靠粘胶贴附在设备机身上。
据了解，这款保护壳采用上下分离式双件结构，在内侧边缘预设有粘胶条。包装内附带的说明卡指导用户先撕除胶条保护膜，再分别将两部分安装到 iPhone Duo 上，并通过按压使其牢固贴合机身。
在材质方面，iPhone Duo保护壳采用聚碳酸酯材料打造，提供沙色和海军蓝两种配色。设计上主要保护机身背部摄像头区域以及外侧显示屏周边框架，前方为外屏预留开孔。不过，当设备展开后，内部柔性显示屏并不会受到保护壳覆盖，因此无法为展开状态下的屏幕提供额外防护。
部分率先体验配件的用户表示，这款保护壳拥有不错的防滑手感，支架版配件的铰链结构也较为扎实，但其固定方式与其他折叠屏手机配件类似，同样需要借助粘胶贴来实现稳固安装。
除了这款79美元的标准保护壳外，苹果还推出了售价129美元的 iPhone Duo Folio 带支架保护套。与标准保护壳不同，Folio 版本采用磁吸连接方式，无需使用粘胶即可固定在机身上。不过，该产品并不会保护设备侧边，而且在使用过程中会遮挡外侧显示屏。苹果通过磁吸结构设计，使用户在需要使用外屏时能够轻松将保护盖向后折叠。
iPhone Duo 于当地时间10月16日正式开启预购。虽然首批新机预计要到下周五才会开始送达消费者手中，但相关保护壳产品已经率先在零售渠道上架销售。
由于市场需求旺盛，iPhone Duo 首批库存已经售罄。目前所有容量和颜色版本的发货时间均已被推迟至2027年1月25日左右。与此同时，消费者已经可以提前购买官方配件，其中标准保护壳售价79美元，Folio 带支架保护套售价129美元。

IT之家从报道获悉，随着这一任命落地，苹果现任商业与竞争诉讼副总裁希瑟 · 格雷尼尔（Heather Grenier）的汇报层级有所下移，改为向塔克汇报，而不再直接向纽斯特德汇报；不过，格雷尼尔仍将保留在纽斯特德的法务核心领导层内。
除在 Meta 的任职经历外，塔克此前还曾担任摩根士丹利高级法律职务，这些经验与他新负责的金融服务领域高度契合。纽斯特德在 Meta 担任首席法律高管六年，并于今年 3 月出任苹果公司总法律顾问。
与此同时，苹果法务部门的另一位资深成员、长期负责监管及产品相关法律事务的副总裁凯尔 · 安德尔（Kyle Andeer），其管辖权责也进一步扩大。他将接管国际法律事务，并全面监管涉及儿童网络安全、网络安全保障以及执法合规合作等业务板块。
苹果与 Meta 的发言人均对此拒绝置评。
上述人事调整属于纽斯特德主导的更广泛组织重组的一部分，目前她全面统辖苹果的法律与政府事务团队。苹果近期还聘请了前美国航空集团高管内特 · 加滕（Nate Gatten）担任政府事务副总裁，并在多个海外区域任命了新的政府事务主管。
在环境、政策及社会倡议事务前负责人丽莎 · 杰克逊（Lisa Jackson）和前首席法务官凯特 · 亚当斯（Kate Adams）相继退休后，苹果将法律团队与政府事务团队整合归入纽斯特德麾下。目前转任公司执行董事长的原首席执行官蒂姆 · 库克，也在政府事务领域扮演着核心领导角色。
当前苹果深陷多条司法战线，包括美国司法部发起的一项重磅反垄断诉讼、与 Epic Games 就 App Store 抽成限制展开的长年纠纷，以及围绕用户隐私与 Siri 功能推迟交付的相关诉讼。
近年来，苹果面临的裁决赔偿与和解金额累计已高达数十亿美元，欧美监管机构也对其支撑商业模式的核心业务行为展开了轮番调查与施压。部分苹果高管认为，公司在法庭诉讼中的表现未达预期，尤其是在 App Store 相关诉讼中处于被动。
这些法律挫折迫使苹果调整其佣金分成比例及向开发者收费的边界条件，这也为近年来作为苹果核心增长引擎的服务业务蒙上了增速明显放缓的阴影。服务业务增长遇阻，将对苹果整体的财务表现带来沉重打击。
即便是放在常态时期，统管苹果庞大的诉讼业务也是一项极其棘手的工作。这家总部位于加州库比蒂诺的科技巨头是全球遭遇诉讼最频繁的企业之一，案情跨度极大 —— 从零售门店发生的顾客滑倒摔伤索赔，到涉案金额达数十亿美元的重磅反垄断纠纷，不一而足。
最近数周，新任 CEO 特努斯主导了一系列大刀阔斧的高管重组，包括为 App Store、大型发布活动，以及信息安全与房地产等公司职能部门调派新负责人。这轮人事洗牌还涉及任职多年的 Apple Pay 负责人离职、更换公司并购（M&A）主管，以及对硬件工程部门架构的大规模调整。

这意味着同一个设备可以根据铰链的具体状态，呈现出多种使用形态。对新手而言这听起来有些繁琐，但它恰恰是这款产品的主要优势之一。
理解这一切的关键，是所谓的"铰链状态"。手机通过侦测铰链的角度来调整屏幕内容的呈现方式，以匹配当下最合适的使用场景。
铰链处于零度时意味着手机闭合，内容只应显示在外屏上；处于180度时则完全相反，内容转到内屏显示；介于两者之间的角度，决定的则是屏幕内容的具体排布方式。
类似能力在其他折叠屏上也有出现，比如三星Z Fold 8 Ultra提供的"Flex Mode"（柔性模式），不过这项功能在护照形态的三星Z Fold 8上已被取消。
具体到使用层面，苹果iPhone Duo共有六种模式：
最基础的是闭合状态，此时仅有5.4英寸（约13.7厘米）外屏可用，灵动岛与挖孔自拍相机都移到了屏幕右侧一个新的竖向位置。
这一形态适合处理不需要大屏的快速任务，比如查看通知、回复简短消息、接听电话或使用Apple Wallet。

完全展开后，手机切换到7.6英寸（约19.3厘米）的内屏，默认以横向显示。这块屏幕尺寸已接近平板，适合观影、游戏、绘画，或者把两个应用并排运行，相当于娱乐与办公的默认形态。屏幕右上角的屏下摄像头让它也适合FaceTime等视频通话。如果改为纵向使用，则不会依赖铰链状态，导航栏会移到底部，更长的宽高比让电子书与网页文章的阅读更舒适，记笔记更顺手、滚动次数更少，还能把两个应用上下堆叠，竖版视频也能占据更多屏幕。
铰链超过90度、接近完全展开时进入书本模式，外形像一本打开的书。此时界面元素会自动避开屏幕中间的折痕，避免内容落在失真区域。
这种形态适合以读书的方式阅读，也方便在配合Apple Pencil时握住手机中部，还能在无支架的情况下平放，从而触发StandBy模式。
把手机折成约90度、像笔记本一样立起来则是桌面模式，屏幕会沿折痕分区，同一应用的不同内容分置两边，适合免手持视频通话、长曝光或定时拍照，以及边看串流边查看简介与评论。
最后一种是把手机折成V形立在平面上、外屏朝外的帐篷模式。
此时内屏关闭，全部显示工作交由外屏承担，既省去了支架，也让内容播放的功耗更低，立起来后还能显示StandBy的时钟与其他小组件。
六种模式覆盖了从随手回复消息到沉浸观影的各类场景，切换方式基本不需要手动设置。

units.text: iPhone Duo pre-orders opened today, but if you weren’t there right at the start, you likely now can’t get one before 2027. That makes the iPhone Duo launch a massive success, but also reflects a missed opportunity for Apple.
iPhone Duo had a flawless product introduction, sparking more excitement than any recent model

Before the iPhone Duo was unveiled last month, I was unsure how the public would respond to the new model. Would it seem too weird compared to standard iPhones? Would the $2,000+ price tag limit early adopters to tech enthusiasts like me?
Yet in my estimation, Apple has pulled off a basically flawless product introduction.

Starting with the September 9 unveiling, iPhone Duo’s marketing rollout has been among the best I’ve seen from Apple. The company knew it had a uniquely special product, and has given it the first-class treatment.

Anecdotally, iPhone Duo has stirred more excitement than any other recent model I can remember. Not just among “techie” early adopters, not just among the ultra-wealthy, and not even just among current iPhone users. Some of my Android friends even seem very interested.

All of this buzz was seemingly proven genuine by today’s near instant sell-out after pre-orders went live. Current shipping estimates for new orders are pushed back to late January 2027. That’s more than three months backordered—an unprecedented delay.
And today’s launch I think can be described both as a huge win and also a missed opportunity for Apple.
Instant iPhone Duo sellout is both a big win and a problem

It’s remarkable that Apple was able to introduce a foldable iPhone, which costs $2,000+, and instantly sell out. It’s amazing how much interest and excitement the iPhone Duo has garnered from a wide-ranging base of “average consumers.”
But it’s also a big problem that Apple can’t deliver anywhere close to a supply-demand balance for such a desired, ultra-premium product.

It’s not a surprise that the iPhone Duo quickly became backordered. But getting pushed out three months within 30 minutes of pre-orders opening proves just how much trouble Apple has had mass-producing the Duo.

Ideally, Apple would have enough supply to meet demand. More realistically, it should be able to meet initial demand within the first 4-6 weeks or so.

But what we’re seeing is in some ways a worst-case scenario. Not just because customers will be frustrated, but chiefly because Apple is sacrificing a lot of revenue by not being able to deliver the iPhone Duo in a reasonable timeframe.

Again, overall today’s launch is a major win for Apple. But being able to capitalize more fully on its basically flawless iPhone Duo marketing plan would have been an even bigger win. Here’s hoping mass production of the iPhone Duo is able to speed up soon.

units.text: Apple has issued a short statement following strong initial demand for the iPhone Duo, with shipping estimates already slipping into next year. Here’s what the company said.
Apple comments on ‘extraordinary’ demand

As soon as iPhone Duo pre-orders opened today, shipping estimates began slipping from late October into November, then December, and eventually January. In some countries, including Brazil, estimated deliveries have already been pushed into early February.
While there had been reports warning that initial iPhone Duo supplies could be limited, the speed and extent of the shipping delays still caught many by surprise.
Apple, meanwhile, is putting a positive spin on the strong initial response. In a statement shared with CNBC, the company described pre-order demand as “nothing short of extraordinary”, and added:
“We are working hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers’ hands as quickly as possible, and we will continue accepting orders online.”
With shipping dates slipping well into next year, scalpers on eBay and X are already looking to cash in, with asking prices reaching as high as $10,000.
This has led to criticism of Apple’s handling of pre-orders, with some calling on the company to identify and cancel orders placed by scalpers.

units.text: New App Store Rules Target AI Deepfakes and Nudify Apps

Apple today expanded its App Store moderation rules to cover AI-generated nonconsensual intimate imagery. Sexually explicit content was already banned, but now Apple says app developers must proactively prevent and remove AI-generated deepfakes from their platforms. Apple warns that apps with offending content could be removed from the ‌App Store‌ if developers fail to act.

The updated 1.2 rule names AI content creation apps and could be targeting apps like Grok, among others. Users have complained about xAI's Grok chatbot being used for nude and sexualized deepfakes, and earlier this year, Apple told xAI it would remove Grok from the ‌App Store‌ if it continued to permit nude deepfakes. xAI put safeguards in place, and Apple approved an updated version of the app.

Apple also added guideline 2.5.19 to clarify that developers who add features or functionality not present in the version of an app submitted for review risk removal from the ‌App Store‌ and Apple Developer Program. Apple links the rule to "nudification" apps that create sexually explicit images of real individuals without their consent, suggesting some of the apps have concealed their true purpose during review and added the nudify feature after approval.

Apps containing hidden or undocumented features are also prohibited on the App Store, including apps that misrepresent their purpose during review and only reveal harmful capabilities — such as "nudification" — after approval, a tactic commonly known as bait-and-switch.
Along with changes focused on AI-generated content, Apple updated section 5 to extend its ban on apps that facilitate human trafficking or child exploitation to alternative app distribution.
"We do not hesitate to remove apps, and terminate the developers behind them, when they violate these guidelines," reads Apple's developer news post on the rule changes.
Apple's full updated guidelines can be found on its website.

units.text: Apple updated its App Review Guidelines today with a series of changes meant to strengthen protections against harmful content and deceptive app review practices. Here are the details.
A bit of context

Over the past year alone, there has been no shortage of reports and controversies involving apps that skirt Apple’s App Review Guidelines and expose users, including minors, to harmful or inappropriate content.
In January, the Tech Transparency Project (TTP) identified dozens of AI-powered “nudify” apps on the App Store.

The group published a follow-up investigation in April, revealing that Apple’s App Store search suggestions and advertisements were also directing users to such apps. In July, San Francisco officials ordered Apple to remove eight apps capable of generating nonconsensual intimate imagery.
Also in July, a 9to5Mac investigation uncovered dozens of apps disguising gambling platforms as simple games and utilities to evade App Store review, many of which were available to children.
These apps behaved as advertised when accessed from outside Brazil, but revealed hidden betting platforms when opened from Brazilian IP addresses.

And then there was the Grok controversy, which saw Elon Musk’s AI chatbot used to generate nonconsensual sexualized images of women and minors, prompting lawmakers and advocacy groups to call on Apple to remove X and Grok from the App Store. Apple later confirmed that it had privately warned xAI that Grok could be removed unless the company addressed the issue.
Today, Apple updated its App Review Guidelines in an attempt to address problems such as these.
Apple’s updated App Review Guidelines
Under Section 1.2, which covers user-generated content, the guidelines now read (changes in bold):

Apps that enable users to create, generate, upload, share, or otherwise contribute content present particular challenges, including intellectual property infringement, nonconsensual intimate imagery, and anonymous bullying.

Apple’s new terms add that “Developers who fail to implement appropriate safeguards or fail to remediate identified violations after notice may be considered in violation of the Developer Code of Conduct.”

In another particularly important change, Apple strengthened its rules against so-called ‘bait-and-switch’ apps, which “misrepresent their purpose during review and only reveal harmful capabilities — such as “nudification” — after approval,” as the company puts it.
The newly created section 2.5.19 reads:

Don’t include any hidden, dormant, or undocumented features in your app; your app’s functionality should be clear to end users and App Review. Attempting to hide undocumented features in your app binary, such as through code obfuscation or other methods, is grounds for removal of your app from the App Store and termination of your developer account.

units.text: Apple Calls iPhone Duo Demand 'Extraordinary' After Orders Slip to 2027

Demand for the iPhone Duo has been "nothing short of extraordinary," Apple said in a statement to the Financial Times. The company also said it is "working hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as quickly as possible."

Pre-orders for the ‌iPhone Duo‌ opened this morning at 5 a.m. Pacific Time, and it didn't take long for available stock to dwindle. Within minutes, delivery dates slipped from October 23 to November, and by 5:30 a.m., delivery estimates reached January 25.

It is no longer possible to order an ‌iPhone Duo‌ for delivery in 2026 from Apple, and customers who purchase now will be waiting until early 2027. Prior to pre-orders launching, rumors said supplies could be constrained due to manufacturing difficulties.

With past iPhone launches where supplies were limited, Apple has sometimes been able to ship devices sooner than expected, so it's possible the company will work through its backlog ahead of schedule. There are no guarantees, though, and it's clear many will be waiting for months.

Apple has not yet said whether there will be ‌iPhone Duo‌ stock available for walk-in purchases on October 23, but if there is, we could see long lines outside Apple retail stores for the first time in several years.
Apple's website suggests there could be some stock available for store pickup as soon as next week, as there is a note to check back on October 24 for availability.
Pricing on the ‌iPhone Duo‌ starts at $1,999 and goes up to $3,199 for 2TB of storage. The first orders will be delivered to customers on October 23.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，理想汽车今日发布新一期答网友问，公布了关于 2026 款理想 i6 智能座舱的几大升级。
IT之家从官方介绍获悉，2026 款理想 i6 支持 Apple CarPlay、HUAWEI HiCar 和 ICCOA Carlink。手机连上车机后，原车的车辆控制、驾驶信息、空调、座椅调节等功能照常可用，车机 App 和手机 App 之间也可以丝滑切换。
2026 款理想 i6 的 29 英寸 6K 全景屏，不只是把屏幕做得更大、更清楚，也重新考虑了主驾、副驾和停车休息时，大家各自最常用的体验。
开车时，信息看得更清楚：大卡片式桌面让常用信息一目了然；副驾无人或暂不使用屏幕时，更多显示空间会留给主驾。打开地图后，显示宽度增加近 1.5 倍，让导航视野更加开阔。
副驾看视频时，可以随心调节尺寸：副驾视频区域可以缩小扩大，支持 16:9 无黑边显示，主驾应用窗口自动调整。
停车后，大屏沉浸式观影：支持全尺寸 21:9 视频播放，并可根据大家的喜好选择居左、居中或居右显示，让车内成为一个自在的私人观影空间。
理想还在全景屏中加入了一些小功能。比如，桌面底部的常用功能栏增加了动态模糊效果，界面切换更自然；三指横划可以切换到“放空桌面”，流动光影会跟随氛围灯变化，听歌时还能同步显示歌词。

原本国行版本起售价15999元的iPhone Duo，在首发阶段的高溢价加持下实际到手价还要高出一大截，不少普通消费者觉得定价偏高，但很多人不知道的是，国行这个定价放在全球各个地区的销售版本里，其实并不算高。
根据汇总统计的不同国家和地区的iPhone Duo官方定价来看，全球售价最贵的版本出现在土耳其，当地起售价换算成人民币高达31450元，国内国行的起售价差不多只有土耳其版本的一半。
紧随土耳其之后的高价地区是巴西和印度，当地的iPhone Duo起售价换算成人民币分别达到28372元和20953元，定价都远高于国行版本。
目前全球售价最低的是美国市场，当地起售价换算成人民币约合13407元，比国行定价低的还有加拿大、日本等地区，当地售价换算之后分别为14860元、15554元，但和国行的差价幅度并不算大。
在存储芯片成本持续上涨、中低端手机利润空间被不断挤压的大背景下，折叠屏作为当前市场渗透率还不高、定价空间足够大的新兴品类，正成为全球各大手机厂商争夺高价值高端市场的核心抓手。
折叠屏赛道的高利润属性，主要体现在两个维度，一是产品整体均价还在持续向上探涨，二是不需要走大量出货的走量路线，就能给厂商创造远高于直板旗舰的销售利润。
从近两年的市场数据也能印证这个趋势，国内市场折叠屏手机的平均售价，短短两年时间里就上涨了接近三成。
现在问题来了，你工作多久能买一部iPhone Duo呢？
